minor.issue: PytestRemovedIn10Warning: class-scoped fixtures defined as instance methods (in test_connections_bugfix.py). Cosmetic — tests pass and behavior is correct. Recommend @classmethod for future maintainability.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 983 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold recommended for splitting. Consider splitting connections routes, insights (LLM) routes, and auth wiring into separate modules.

In apify_client.fetch_connection_list (line 174-177), HTTPException is caught and swallowed to return [] on Apify failure — while this enables 'quota_exhausted' UX, it also silently hides real 5xx errors from the client. Consider logging + surfacing a non-fatal warning field in the mutuals response too (currently only relies on the empty-list branch).

The mutuals endpoint fetches followers and following via asyncio.gather (good), but if ONE of them errors while the other succeeds, both are effectively discarded (mutual_count becomes small silently). Consider distinguishing partial-fetch vs full-quota-exhausted in the response.

The old /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (551 lines, pre-auth) will now fail wholesale under the JWT protection because it never logs in. It was updated by conftest.http fixture so it auto-logs in — good — but it references '_seed' cleanup in classes that may leak seed data if tests are interrupted.

If Apify quota exhausts, endpoints return quota_exhausted=true and tests skip semantic checks.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration was a verification run for a previously fixed bug. Original RCA (per review_request): apify_client.fetch_connection_list was passing param name `selectType` which the scraping_solutions~instagram-scraper-followers-following-no-cookies actor silently ignored, so it always returned the same default (followers) regardless of the requested list type. Fix confirmed in place: uses `dataToScrape` in {Followers, Followings} with resultsLimit >= 50, and cache_key versioned to `v2_...` to invalidate old broken cache. Verified via live Apify calls that lists are now distinct and semantics are correct.
